# Arazzo schema fixture

`arazzo-1.0.schema.json` is the OpenAPI Initiative's official, non-normative
Arazzo 1.0.x schema, iteration 2025-10-15, downloaded from
<https://spec.openapis.org/arazzo/1.0/schema/2025-10-15>.

The schema is maintained in
<https://github.com/OAI/spec.openapis.org/blob/main/arazzo/1.0/schema/2025-10-15>.
The upstream Apache 2.0 license is included as `LICENSE`.

Tests validate both frozen-contract and observed-source exports against this
local fixture without fetching remote schema resources.
